verdict.rationale: Anrok is a SaaS tax platform with AI features (AI Atlas, agent access), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes a training opt-out, a data-use policy, or any control that keeps customer data out of AI model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
